name: Concord Custom Furniture
old_description: Fueling his ambition, Jeff founded Concord Custom Furniture LLC, aiming to offer a personal and tailored experience for each customer. With a commitment to using the finest specialty woods, the company endeavors to craft the ideal furniture piece that perfectly complements your home or office. Connect with Jeff today to begin the journey of creating your very own custom masterpiece!
about:
Concord Custom Furniture operates from Concord, New Hampshire. The company was founded by Jeff Labrecque, who established the business to provide a personal and tailored experience for each customer. Ownership details beyond the founder are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces bespoke furniture pieces, ranging from traditional to contemporary designs, all meticulously handcrafted using specialty woods. The company does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures, but emphasizes a made-to-order approach for both residential and commercial clients.

Its customer base includes homeowners seeking custom pieces for living spaces and offices requiring tailored furnishings. The company cites examples such as a craft table built for a family, indicating a focus on one-off commissions rather than volume production.

Labrecque started the venture to offer a personalized design journey, combining client vision with handcrafted execution. The company highlights its commitment to the finest specialty woods and attention to detail as its defining differentiators.
